inputs.name: sdk_version
inputs.description: The .NET SDK release to install, such as "10.0.403". Change checksums with it.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the linux-x64 and linux-arm64 SDK tarballs. Microsoft publishes SHA-512, so check that first; the README shows how. Change these with sdk_version.

inputs.name: telemetry
inputs.description: Let the .NET CLI send Microsoft its usage telemetry. Off by default: the dotnet command sets DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1.
